title: Simple Factory for Document Processors
instructions: Implement the three processors in `document/products.py` (type, one-line `process_document`, and the extra `perform_data_analysis` / `add_slide`) and the static `DocumentFactory.create_document` in `document/factory.py`. The factory builds only the selected processor and raises `ValueError` for an unsupported type.

evidence.label: The factory returns the right processor for each document type
process_document() prints one line containing the document name
Each processor's output describes its own kind of document
Spreadsheet analysis and presentation add_slide exist only where they belong
Each call returns a new processor with its own name
Only the selected processor is constructed
Every DocumentType is supported through the base interface
